name: Agawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Agawa village emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised star-like device with horizontal strokes.
history: Flag of the former village of Agawa in Kōchi Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-08-01.

features.role: Agawa village emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised star-like device with horizontal strokes
